title: account.payment.register — Wizard Payment Posting Chain L3

key_findings.memo_multi_outbound: sorted unique references joined by comma-space
key_findings.group_payment_default: True when single-invoice batch, False for multi-invoice
key_findings.reconcile_method: reconcile() called per shared account between payment lines and invoice lines
key_findings.draft_invoice_guard: forces payment_difference_handling='open' when any source line is draft
key_findings.clean_context_applied: True — strips default_* keys before account.payment create
key_findings.sibling_companies_sudo: True — uses sudo() for cross-branch payments

neutral_ref_map.N-U172-01: Wizard is a transient model — ephemeral, auto-purged after session
neutral_ref_map.N-U172-02: Source lines passed through context, filtered to outstanding receivable/payable
neutral_ref_map.N-U172-03: Payment amount is auto-computed from residual but user-editable
neutral_ref_map.N-U172-04: Group payment merges multiple invoices per partner into one payment
neutral_ref_map.N-U172-05: Journal currency takes priority over source and company currencies
neutral_ref_map.N-U172-06: Available journals restricted to bank/cash/credit with compatible payment method lines
neutral_ref_map.N-U172-07: Difference handling: keep open or write off to nominated account
neutral_ref_map.N-U172-08: Batch key groups by partner, account, currency, bank account, and direction
neutral_ref_map.N-U172-09: Batches computed from line grouping; payment direction from balance sign
neutral_ref_map.N-U172-10: Single batch enables editable mode; multiple batches force read-only mode
neutral_ref_map.N-U172-11: Group payment defaults to True for single-invoice batches
neutral_ref_map.N-U172-12: Journal selected by preferred method, then batch heuristic, then first available
neutral_ref_map.N-U172-13: Batch journal tries currency+bank, bank-only, currency-only, then any journal
neutral_ref_map.N-U172-14: Memo derived from payment reference, then ref, then name; multiple joined
neutral_ref_map.N-U172-15: Edit-mode payment vals include all wizard fields including destination account
neutral_ref_map.N-U172-16: Write-off vals populated for EPD or standard difference with nominated account
neutral_ref_map.N-U172-17: Batch-mode payment vals use batch residual amounts and source currency
neutral_ref_map.N-U172-18: Edit mode requires single-batch editable mode plus single line or group flag
neutral_ref_map.N-U172-19: Ungrouped mode splits each batch into one sub-batch per invoice
neutral_ref_map.N-U172-20: Payments created in one call; currency mismatch balance adjusted post-create
neutral_ref_map.N-U172-21: Post step calls action_post in batch with sale invoice send suppressed
neutral_ref_map.N-U172-22: Reconcile step matches payment lines to invoice lines by account
neutral_ref_map.N-U172-23: Full sequence: create draft, post, reconcile — reconciliation is immediate
neutral_ref_map.N-U172-24: Confirm action forces open handling for draft invoices; returns payment action
neutral_ref_map.N-U172-25: default_get filters lines, validates company/direction/blocked constraints
neutral_ref_map.N-U172-26: Batches skipped when bank account required but absent or untrusted
neutral_ref_map.N-U172-27: Payment difference is residual minus wizard amount; open leaves invoice partial
neutral_ref_map.N-U172-28: Exchange account detected; uses force_balance instead of write-off entry
neutral_ref_map.N-U172-29: Sibling-branch payments use elevated access; redirect suppressed
neutral_ref_map.N-U172-30: Context cleaned before payment create to prevent default key bleeding
